short_answer: Tony T is Tony Tellez, a long running pick seller. A 2018 press release says he runs Tony's Picks and heads a team of handicappers, and his podcast listing says he once hosted a picks show called Gamblers Television. A forum post from September 2009 already promoted him under that title. Today he sells passes and small packages on PickDawgz and posts free picks, videos and podcasts on tonyspicks.com almost every day. In that sense the service is real and active.

Unlike most sellers, PickDawgz shows a long pick history for him: about 310 pages going back to 1 Jan 2024. We read all of it on 17 Nov 2026. By our count he went 1,531 and 1,493 with 19 pushes, a 50.6% win rate. For the 1,407 picks since 16 Jun 2025, where the list shows the side and the price, a flat 1 unit bet on every pick would have lost about 37 units. Baseball was the one sport that came out ahead in that stretch.

So Tony T is a real, active seller, but the record his own storefront publishes does not show a long run profit. Prices are clear. The guarantee only gives store credit, and "All sales are final." If you buy, log every pick yourself and compare it with the posted history.

guarantee: PickDawgz says: "Guaranteed packages automatically give you a credit if the package does not turn a profit" and "a credit for its full purchase price is automatically issued after picks are graded and verified." It adds that "Credits expire 9 months after they are added to your account." On 17 Nov 2026 only the $50.00 three pick package carried the "Credit Guaranteed" label. The four passes did not.

The PickDawgz terms say "All sales are final regardless of the duration of membership access" and "The credit guarantee has no redeemable value other than to be used for additional access to content." A refund is mentioned only when a buyer cannot get into the account. In plain words: a losing package earns more picks from the same store, never cash, and betting losses are never covered.
The Terms and Conditions link in the tonyspicks.com footer did not load for us on 17 Nov 2026, so we could not read that site's own refund rules.

claims_note: We read every page of the PickDawgz pick history on 17 Nov 2026 and counted the results ourselves. The list kept updating while we read it, so our totals could be off by a few picks. Every number on this page marked "our count" comes from that list, which PickDawgz grades.

Units are a problem in this business because each site uses its own scale. Tony's Picks posts figures like +480 units for a 41 and 32 month, and PickDawgz showed +75 units for a 2 and 1 record. Neither page explains what a unit is. We use one plain rule instead: risk 1 unit on every pick at the price shown. We also checked a second way, betting to win 1 unit on favorites, and the direction did not change.
Before 16 Jun 2025 the PickDawgz list shows the prices of both sides of each game rather than only the side Tony T took, so we could count wins and losses for that period but not units.
record: What a buyer can verify independently: nothing we could find. There is no third party audit, no contest result we could open, and no court or regulator record about him.

What the seller publishes: PickDawgz keeps a pick history for Tony T that runs from 1 Jan 2024 to 16 Nov 2026. Our count of it: 545 and 551 in 2024, 535 and 513 with 7 pushes in 2025, and 451 and 429 with 12 pushes in 2026 so far. That is 50.6% winners overall. At typical prices near -110, about 52.4% is needed to break even.

Since 16 Jun 2025, when the list began showing only his side and its price, he went 711 and 678 with 18 pushes over 1,407 picks. At 1 unit per pick that is about minus 37 units, a return of about minus 2.6% on money risked. By sport in that stretch: MLB 366 and 305 (about plus 27 units), college basketball 100 and 94 (about minus 5), NBA 68 and 71 (about minus 10), WNBA 25 and 26 (about minus 4), college football 78 and 84 (about minus 14), NFL 74 and 98 (about minus 31).

Recent form on the same list is weak: the last 20 picks went 7 and 13, the last 100 went 46 and 52 with 2 pushes, and the 2026 football season so far is 50 and 66 with 4 pushes. The picture is a long record near a coin flip, with a profitable baseball stretch and losing football and basketball.

customers_intro: We looked for buyer reports on Reddit (through the Arctic Shift archive), TheRX, Sportsbook Review, Covers and the Better Business Bureau. We found no buyer describing a purchase from Tony T or Tony's Picks, good or bad.

customers.text: There is almost no independent talk about Tony T. We found two public mentions across 2009 and 2021: a promotional TheRX post that sent readers to his site, and a Reddit list of free betting sites that included tonyspicks.com without anyone discussing it. We found no complaints about billing or refunds, and no praise from buyers either. The Reddit search was partial: one archive search returned results and the other timed out. With no buyer voices, the best evidence is the seller's own pick list, which by our count sits near break even on wins and losses and loses money at a flat stake since June 2025.

A post in the TheRX Site Promotions forum listed Sunday football games and described Tony T as the host of Gamblers Television, pointing readers to his own site for the plays. It is a promotional post with no replies, so it shows how long he has been selling, not how his picks did.

A Reddit r/sportsbook member listed about two dozen sites, tonyspicks.com among them, that they read every day for free analysis, and asked about their reputation. The six replies discussed free analysis sites in general and said nothing about Tony's Picks itself.

A Better Business Bureau search for tonyspicks returned no results. Our web searches found no Sportsbook Review or Covers thread about Tony T or Tony's Picks. In the Reddit archive, a search of r/sportsbook found only the 2021 list above, a search of r/sportsbetting timed out, and our saved Reddit archive had no posts about him (only posts about a baseball player with the same surname).

conflicts: PickDawgz both sells Tony T's packages and grades the pick history shown on his page. Tony's Picks, which publishes the leaderboard posts praising him, is his own site and sells his packages and those of his team.
The Tony's Picks leaderboard posts rank Tony Tellez and the other handicappers the site sells. They are marketing written by the seller, even when they quote real records.
We saw no sportsbook affiliate banners on the Tony T pages we read. PickDawgz is run by Dawn Patrol LLC, which its terms say also runs SportsChatPlace.com.
strengths: A real, long running seller: promoted under the Tony T name since at least 2009, with a press release from 2018 and daily free picks, videos and podcasts in 2026.
PickDawgz shows a long pick history for him, about 3,000 graded picks back to 1 Jan 2024, including the losses. Most sellers show only hot streaks.
Every PickDawgz package and pass has a clear published price, from $50.00 to $1,299.99.
His baseball picks were profitable in the stretch we could price: 366 and 305 since 16 Jun 2025, about plus 27 units at a flat stake.
He posts many free picks with written reasons on tonyspicks.com, so you can follow him for a while before paying.
concerns: The full history is 50.6% winners by our count, below the roughly 52.4% needed at -110. Since June 2025 a flat 1 unit stake on every pick lost about 37 units.
Football has been weak: NFL 74 and 98 and college football 78 and 84 since June 2025, and 50 and 66 so far in the 2026 season, while the bio still calls him a leaderboard fixture "this season."
The guarantee is store credit only, it applied to just the $50.00 package on the day we checked, credits expire after 9 months, and "All sales are final."
Unit figures on the sales pages (+2350, +480, +75) use a scale that is never explained, so they cannot be compared with anything.
The Tony's Picks terms page did not load and its store prices were not readable, so a buyer there has less written information than on PickDawgz.
We found no independent buyer reports at all, positive or negative.
checklist: Open the PickDawgz pick history and read several pages yourself, not just the bio. Compare the last few months with the season claims.
Count units at a flat stake, not wins. A record near 50% at -110 loses money.
Check which packages carry the "Credit Guaranteed" label. On the day we checked, the passes did not.
Remember credits expire 9 months after they are added and are never paid out in cash.
If a sport is his strength in the posted record (here, baseball), judge him on that sport over a few hundred plays, not on a hot week.
Write down each pick the moment you receive it, with the line you can actually get, and compare it with what the site later grades.
faq: Tony T is Tony Tellez, a real seller who has promoted picks under that name since at least 2009 and sells on PickDawgz and his own site. We found no court or regulator action and no buyer complaints. The pick history his storefront publishes does not show long run profit by our count.
How much does Tony T cost?

On 17 Nov 2026 PickDawgz sold a three pick package for $50.00, a 3 day pass for $99.95, a 7 day pass for $179.95, a 30 day pass for $329.99 and a 1 year pass for $1,299.99. Tony's Picks advertised 50% off a first purchase with code PICK50.
Does Tony T have a verified record?

Not an independent one. PickDawgz publishes a long history graded by itself. Our count of it is 1,531 wins, 1,493 losses and 19 pushes from 1 Jan 2024 to 16 Nov 2026, and about minus 37 units at a flat stake since 16 Jun 2025.
What is Tony T's best sport?
In the posted history, baseball. Since 16 Jun 2025 his MLB picks went 366 and 305, about plus 27 units at 1 unit per pick. NFL and college football lost the most in the same period.
Does Tony T offer a refund?
No cash refund. PickDawgz gives site credit for the full price when a "Credit Guaranteed" package does not profit, credits expire after 9 months, and its terms say all sales are final.

You get every pick he releases in the period you buy, plus plenty of free picks and videos. What the posted record does not show is a lasting edge: about 50.6% winners overall and a loss at a flat stake since June 2025. Try the free picks and track them before paying.
